VI.description: Calls the class subject's STUB\2C whose Gadget in and Gadget out are `path` stand-ins where Read Config.vi has a class refnum. Retargeting this call onto the subject with pylabview is the route section 12c warns about\3A the pane's type descriptor is part of the link binding\2C so a stand-in that is a different TYPE should answer Error 7\2C Bad Linkage. This VI exists to measure that rather than assert it.

Control.description: The path stand-in the stub declares in place of the class wire.
